  WHY: The unit fails on both trees, so it is classified `inherited` and map_entry returns not_reproduced/pre_existing. The line 84 assertion `("reproduced", "regression")` then always fails when HEAL_REPRODUCE_DOCKER_E2E=1 and Docker is present. ci.yml never sets HEAL_REPRODUCE_DOCKER_E2E, so CI hides the failure. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; minimax filed it under SECURITY & INPUT VALIDATION.
- tests/test_heal_reproduce.py:310-317 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `assert "--timeout-minutes 7 " in h.read("docker.log")` expects an exact value, but scripts/heal_reproduce.sh line 451 computes `minutes=$(( (heal_repro_inner_deadline - now - 180) / 60 ))` with floor division after the inner pass has done setup work (bash spawn, git merge-base, `git worktree add`, fake codex_isolated_exec spawns).
  WHY: With a deadline of T0+600, the result is 7 only when no whole second elapses (Δ=0); any Δ≥1 gives 6, so the test is flaky under CI load. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. Suggested fixes: a regex accepting [67] (minimax suggested [4-7]), or ceiling division.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:195-220 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Whole-list gate rejections `{"item": "tests_file", "reason": tests_file_too_many_entries|tests_file_unreadable|tests_file_too_large}` (prepush_affected_tests.py:1456, 1496, 1499, 1504) are not treated as gate-level in cmd_map (`("gate", "merge_base")`), so they fall through map_entry to `return "unverified", "not_run"`.
  WHY: The run-level `unverified` status is correct, but each per-test reason reads `not_run` instead of the gate's reason, which the issue requires ("unverified with the gate's reason"). All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:180-190 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the map_entry failures branch, a named `path::name` entry is checked against `names` only when `names` is non-empty, so a file-level failure with no parsed node IDs marks the named test `reproduced`/`regression`.
  WHY: A file-level or collection failure gets reported as a regression without per-test evidence, which can mislabel a passing named test. Severity disagreement: gemini and luna rated it MAJOR, minimax and glm rated it NIT; the highest is used. glm notes that agents.d/heal-reproduce.md documents this behaviour ("or none were parsed"). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined to adopt it for that reason.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:189-191 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The map_entry inherited branch returns `not_reproduced`/`pre_existing` on `item.get("test") == test_path` without checking the listed `::name` against the unit's `names`.
  WHY: In mixed multi-name units (merged into one pytest unit at prepush_affected_tests.py line 610), the per-test reason in heal_repro.v1 can be wrong; the run-level not_reproduced status is unaffected. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/heal_reproduce.sh:281-302, 385-407, 440-447 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The prepare root is written to `${root}/prepare_root` only after `codex_isolated_exec.sh prepare --deps` returns, so if the outer timeout fires during prepare, the parent cleanup trap cannot remove it.
  WHY: An outer timeout during dependency prepare leaks the prepare root. The worktree does not have this problem because it is recorded before creation (line 424). Rated NIT.
